name: kani-tts-2-en-benchmarks-v1
description: A set of English text-to-speech (TTS) evaluation data and benchmarks that measure synthesis quality, intelligibility, and speaker similarity for TTS systems. Evaluations focus on human judgements (e.g., MOS) and objective measures like WER to assess naturalness and accuracy of generated speech. Intended for comparing TTS models and front-end pipelines on English data.
reputation: Niche TTS benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption among TTS researchers and practitioners.
